reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations

title.narrative: Precision Farming for a Greener Tomorrow: Advocating for Sustainable Agriculture

description.narrative:
Overall objective of this action is to enhance the capacities of CSOs to promote sustainable agriculture practices in the context of the European Green Deal.

Specific objectives of the action are the following:

-     To enable the active participation and engagement of CSOs and citizens in sustainable farming and policy-decision making processes.

-      to increase the adoption of sustainable agriculture and precision farming practices, and necessary policy changes in Türkiye by supporting CSOs with the knowledge, skills, resources, networking, and dialogue within civil society and with critical actors of agricultural sector.


The project was awarded under the call for proposal that aimed to support the improvement of the capacities of civil society organisations towards the achievement of the ambitious targets of the European Green Deal.
